planted_patterns.description: When a CFO raises a pricing/budget objection, presenting an ROI case study/financial breakdown yields an 80%+ win rate (Acme Corp, Nexus Health, Vanguard Logistics won with ROI; Omni Finance lost when rep offered only a discount without ROI).
planted_patterns.winning_action: Share 3-year ROI financial model / case study within 48-72 hours of objection.

planted_patterns.description: Deals that stay in Legal Review for > 14 days without an active redline cycle have high probability of stalling or dying due to shifting corporate priorities (Titan Energy lost after 45 days in legal; Horizon Telecom currently at 18 days with overdue commitment).
planted_patterns.preventive_action: Mandate maximum 48-hour SLA on redlines and proactively schedule alignment calls between general counsels.

planted_patterns.description: When the primary champion or economic buyer goes uncontacted or unresponsive for 14+ days, deal progression drops sharply (Summit BioTech champion silent for 18 days; Titan Energy champion went silent before cancellation).
planted_patterns.preventive_action: Trigger executive check-in or deliver overdue commitments immediately.
